headline.text: steven n'zonzi fires blackburn rovers to 1–0 win over manchester united

sentences.text: steven n'zonzi scores the only goal at 27:14 to give blackburn rovers a 1–0 victory against manchester united.
n'zonzi leads with one goal, while paul scholes, david dunn, and mauro formica top pass receptions with six each.
david dunn and gael givet share the highest recoveries at five each.
blackburn rovers take seven shots compared to manchester united's five and receive 31 passes versus 27 for their opponents.
they also make 23 recoveries and hold 51.2% possession during the match.
